scope: one-equal-row-per-site risk prior selected only on authorized cross-site development folds

prohibited: per-scene or per-site label at inference

search.formula: logit(current scene score) + weight * logit(predicted site-has-plume risk)

gates.selection: combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance
gates.confirmation: same fixed candidate has combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance

interpretation.hypothesis: scene ranking at unseen sites needs an explicit site-existence prior trained with equal site weights, not another scene-weighted classifier
interpretation.parameter_selection: folds 2/3/4 only with nested site holdouts

invariants: Every physical site contributes exactly one site-classifier training row regardless of scene count.
Selection site risks are cross-fitted: each site's risk comes from a model trained on other physical-site folds.
The selected site model is fit only on folds 2/3/4 before fold-0/1 confirmation.
A final all-development fit is allowed only after every frozen selection and confirmation gate passes.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety or paper replay.
